scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix web ci --include=dev && npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix server ci
scripts.start: npm --prefix server run migrate && npm --prefix server start
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix web test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.test:plan: npm run test:plan:server && npm run test:plan:web && npm run test:plan:cypress
